description: Lists what the signed-in account has collected, newest first: saved templates (hearted on animatedwebs.com), unlocked Pro templates (opened with a Prompt Pack credit or monthly unlock; fetching their prompt again is free) and AI generations (the prompt, model and date of each generate_component, refine_component or Design AI run; the generated HTML itself is not stored, so regenerate or refine to get code). Use this to pick up earlier work or to avoid spending a credit twice; use get_template_prompt with a returned slug to rebuild a template. Read-only; only the account's own items are visible. Requires sign-in.

type.description: Which list to return; all returns each list.

name: list_my_items
title: List my AnimatedWebs items
